text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: alarms per Primary-year over the whole residual history. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole calendar months. Square-root axis. D18 has only 1 year of residual, so its interval is wide. the first two panels use one threshold in noise units for every Primary, the last two use a threshold tuned on switching labels.'
